thread:
Jon Kline: FYI — Azure reseller invoice for June has a mismatched meterline. Our invoice shows 0 GPU hours for reseller CloudEdge but their statement shows ~1,200 GPU hours. S3 link to invoice: https://s3.redwood.internal/invoices/azure/2026-06/CE-INV-556.pdf
Maria Chen: ugh. do we have the partner usage export? cc @Ash Patel
Ash Patel: they sent an export earlier, I pulled it. looks like the usage is present on their side but our mapping pipeline filtered the metercode. suspect sku_map_v2 behavior.
Kevin Ortiz: rough $ impact ballpark?
Ash Patel: if 1,200 GPU hours * our effective rate = ~$4,300. might be a pricing experiment flip that disabled legacy meter inclusion.
Jon Kline: two asks — (1) confirm whether mapping skipped these metercodes, (2) finance approval path for provisional credit if needed.
Maria Chen: @finance-bot can you create a hold/track ticket so we don't accidentally invoice them for the wrong amount?
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-4782. Provisional credit hold placed for $4,300 pending reconciliation and audit.
Ash Patel: quick snippet from partner export (redacted):
```
metercode,usage,sku
8X-GPU,1200,cloudedge.gpu.standard
```
Our parser in sku_map_v2 has an exclude list that matched metercodes starting with "8X" when the include_legacy flag = false.
Kevin Ortiz: approve provisional up to $5k so ops can issue immediate credit if reconciliation confirms.
Kevin Ortiz: Approving provisional up to $5,000. Please include this in July forecast adjustments. :+1:
Ash Patel: I'll flip include_legacy=true in the mapping config, re-run reconciliation now, and post diffs. ETA ~2h.
Maria Chen: also logging a note for the pricing experiments team — toggling mapping flags is too risky without a canary. tagging @product-experiments team for follow-up.
cloudedge-account: thanks — we appreciate quick turnaround. we'll hold on raising a formal dispute until you confirm.
deploy-bot: mapping-service v2.1 deployed to staging at 12:34 UTC (sha: ab3f2c).
Ash Patel: reconcile finished — confirms 1,198 GPU hours matched after mapping fix (minor rounding). I'll export reconciliation report to FIN-4782 and attach partner-facing credit memo draft.
Jon Kline: great. Maria/Kevin — please sign off on the memo so ops can process.
Maria Chen: signing off after a quick audit of the memo. will post final comment in FIN-4782.
Jon Kline: thanks team — closing the thread here once finance ticket is resolved. :white_check_mark:
